### (d) Needs human eyeball

- Cross-era gate semantics are the plan-v4-amended REGENERATED-GREEDY form (store has no text): PASS certifies the whole generation+extraction chain; FAIL is ambiguous (text drift vs stack drift) and aborts pre-fan-out.
- A0 backend-parity behavior on real hardware unknown (bf16 vLLM-vs-HF greedy divergence rates); per-divergence logit gaps persist in `a0_summary.json` for the analyzer.
- Loader-alias contract: NEW-store npz alias `v0`/`v_plus` = the ON-POLICY legs (so a CellRecord from the new prefix reads v0(R⁺)/v⁺(R⁺)); the fit driver consumes exactly this contract — both halves verified against the same shape, but a reviewer should confirm no consumer reads the alias with old-store semantics.
- Pre-existing fit-driver C7 nuance: with `n_empty>0` in a cell the text-lookup index can drift from `probe_idx` for the edit-distance read (the sha256 exact-match path is alignment-correct via `resp_sha256_base`); greedy chat generations make empties ~0.
- Production MLP-gate wall-time on VM CPU is heavy at full n (knobs: `--mlp-layers`, `--mlp-epochs`, `--mlp-chunk-size`, `--device cuda`, `--skip-mlp`); ridge headline never depends on it.
